problems.statement_en: Consider a partition of an 8 × 8 chessboard into p rectangles whose interiors are disjoint such that each rectangle contains an equal number o f white and black cells. Assume that a1 < a2 < · · ·< ap, where ai denotes the number of white cells in the ith rectangle. Find the maximal p for which such a partition is possible and for that p determine all possible corresponding sequences a1,a2, . . . ,ap.(Bulgaria)
